page.title: WeChat Pay settings
page.intro: Native integration for regular merchants. This site currently uses WeChat Pay public-key mode. Enter the matching WeChat Pay public key and an ID beginning with PUB_KEY_ID_. This is not for service providers or sub-merchants.
page.gate: Only settings can be saved for now. WeChat order integration and provider acceptance are not complete, so the channel remains disabled. A successful save or complete settings does not mean payments can be accepted.
page.purchase_settings: The global purchase switch is in
field.verification_id: Current WeChat Pay public-key ID / platform certificate serial number
field.verification_key: Current WeChat Pay public key / platform certificate (PEM)
field.previous_verification_id: Previous public-key ID / certificate serial during rotation (optional)
field.previous_verification_key: Previous public key / certificate during rotation (PEM, optional)
status.server_gate: The server also blocks activation; changing this page cannot bypass that gate.
status.ready: Technical settings are complete; merchant and live-provider acceptance are still required.
help.secrets: Secrets and PEM materials are encrypted and never shown again. Leave fields blank to keep saved values; select Clear to delete them. PEM fields support multiline paste. Do not send secrets through support tickets, chat, or customer service.
help.verification: For public-key mode, enter the ID beginning with PUB_KEY_ID_ and its matching WeChat Pay public key. For platform-certificate mode, enter the certificate serial and full certificate. When changing an existing ID or merchant certificate serial, provide the matching material too. Previous verification material can be kept during rotation.
help.callbacks: These fixed HTTPS notification paths are reserved for a future integration and cannot currently receive transactions. Saving them does not count as acceptance of notification settings in the merchant console.
status.saved: WeChat Pay settings saved. The channel remains disabled and payment acceptance is incomplete.
error.wechat_setting_invalid: Invalid settings. Check the fields and clear-value selections.
error.wechat_identity_invalid: Check the AppID, merchant ID, and merchant API certificate serial number.
error.wechat_api_v3_key_invalid: The APIv3 key must contain 32 visible ASCII characters.
error.wechat_key_invalid: Use an RSA2048 PKCS#8 private key or a standard public-key PEM.
error.wechat_verification_key_invalid: Invalid verification material. Pair a public-key ID with a public key, or a certificate serial with the full certificate.
error.wechat_verification_certificate_in: The platform certificate serial does not match or its validity period is invalid.
error.wechat_verification_key_duplicate: The current and previous verification material IDs must differ.
error.wechat_rotation_material_required: When changing an existing ID or merchant certificate serial, provide the matching new material too.
error.wechat_callback_url_invalid: Notification URLs must use an allowed HTTPS domain on this site and the fixed path.
error.wechat_checkout_not_integrated: WeChat order integration and acceptance are incomplete. The channel cannot be enabled yet.
error.permission_denied: You do not have permission to manage payment settings.
error.csrf_invalid: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.generic: Settings were not saved. Check the configuration or sign in again.
